activity_contract.focus: Riding, Spear, Bow, Defense, Formation Fighting, Leadership, Formation Command, Tactics
activity_contract.growth_rule: verified elapsed training only; smart rotation prioritizes legal next-rank deficits, current loadout skills, command/logistics needs, and weakest useful stats; no free progress
activity_contract.planned_opportunity: maximum-sustainable deliberate training when health, duty, recovery, travel, command workload, instructors, facilities and equipment permit; real elapsed hours and diminishing returns remain authoritative
activity_contract.smart_rotation: weakest_useful_then_promotion_gate_then_role_and_loadout; deterministic rotation avoids overtraining already-high skills

authority: operational command of force_house_guardian_cavalry under Tang Zhu and Tang Wei

autonomous_activity_state.verification_rule: structured causal cycles derive standard House Tang adult hours from the canonical training regimen; planned_opportunity prose is capacity context only and is never converted into training hours

behavior.concealed_concern: urban political movement may trap mounted forces where their advantages disappear
behavior.conflict_style: offers a safer formation or timing rather than arguing abstractly
behavior.core_traits: controlled, cavalry-minded, protective of readiness, skeptical of ceremonial deployments
behavior.individual_tell: rubs a thumb across an old rein scar when unconvinced
behavior.speech_pattern: concise mounted-movement language; compares plans by route, pace, and remount cost
behavior.values: horse condition, disciplined movement, reserve strength, clear command boundaries

career_state.rank_billet_span_rule: Durable rank, current billet, and current command span are separate saved facts; only explicit promotion/demotion changes rank.

command_assignment.rule: Current command span follows exact surviving/assigned Units and may change without changing durable rank.

equipment_description: Mounted command standard: great war bow, cavalry lance (spear-family), shield, one-handed long sword, Tang armor and helmet, heavy warhorse, tack and horse armor.

current_goals: preserve the Guardian Cavalry as a usable reserve while meeting lawful House Tang needs
institutional_duties: act within current independent political and military obligations

knowledge_boundary: knows cavalry readiness and internal security orders, not sealed court intelligence

military_rank.rule: Only explicit career promotion/demotion changes grade; billet and current troop span changes do not.

name: Zhao Fen
unit_membership: separate named commander outside the 300-person anonymous unit
